text: गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गंधमादनः । मैन्दः च द्विविदः चैव हनूमान् जांबवान् तथा ॥४-२६-३५॥
translation: Then Sugriva was seated facing the east on a golden throne with fine coverings on top of the mansion decorated with multicoloured garlands. As per tradition, sacred waters collected from rivers and rivulets and stored in golden pots was aportioned in accordance with the procedure ordained by the sages in sastras. At the appropriate time the pure and fragrant water was poured by Gaja, Gavaya, Sarabha, Mainda, Dvivida, Hanumanta, Jambavan and Nala on Sugriva, the bull among monkeys through horns of bulls and jars of gold, like the eight Vasus bathed the thousandeyed Indra. Thus they performed the consecration.
word_meanings: ततः then, हेमप्रतिष्ठाने on a golden throne, वरास्तरणसंवृते with fine covering, चित्रमाल्योपशोभिते adorned with beautiful garlands, रम्ये delightful, प्रासादशिखरे on the top of a mansion, वरासने on a fine seat, मन्स्रैः with mantras, विविधैः with various, विधिवत् as per ritual, प्राङ्मुखम् him who was facing east, स्थापयित्वा having made to sit, नदीनदेभ्यः from rivers and rivulets, समन्ततः all together, तीर्थेभ्यश्च from waters, अपः संहृत्य having collected, सर्वेभ्यः from all, समुद्रेभ्यः च and from oceans, विमलम् pure, शुभा auspicious, कनककुम्भेषु in golden pots, निधाय having stored, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभा Sarabha, गन्धमादन Gandhamadana, द्विविदश्चैव and Dvivida, मैन्दश्च Mainda and, हनूमान् Hanuman, नल Nala, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, प्रसन्नेन with pure, सुगन्धिना fragrant, सलिलेन water, शास्त्रदृष्टेन according to sastras, महर्षि विहितेन च aportioned according to the procedure ordained by sages, विधिना as per tradition, शुभैः with auspicious, वृषभशृङ्गैश्च through horns of bulls, काञ्चनैः with golden, कलशैश्चैव pots, वसवः Vasus, सहस्राक्षम् Indra, वासवं यथा like the Indra, अभ्यषिञ्चन्त performed the consecration.

text: अभ्यषिंचंत सुग्रीवम् प्रसन्नेन सुगंधिना । सलिलेन सहस्राक्षम् वसवो वासवम् यथा ॥४-२६-३६॥
translation: Then Sugriva was seated facing the east on a golden throne with fine coverings on top of the mansion decorated with multicoloured garlands. As per tradition, sacred waters collected from rivers and rivulets and stored in golden pots was aportioned in accordance with the procedure ordained by the sages in sastras. At the appropriate time the pure and fragrant water was poured by Gaja, Gavaya, Sarabha, Mainda, Dvivida, Hanumanta, Jambavan and Nala on Sugriva, the bull among monkeys through horns of bulls and jars of gold, like the eight Vasus bathed the thousandeyed Indra. Thus they performed the consecration.
word_meanings: ततः then, हेमप्रतिष्ठाने on a golden throne, वरास्तरणसंवृते with fine covering, चित्रमाल्योपशोभिते adorned with beautiful garlands, रम्ये delightful, प्रासादशिखरे on the top of a mansion, वरासने on a fine seat, मन्स्रैः with mantras, विविधैः with various, विधिवत् as per ritual, प्राङ्मुखम् him who was facing east, स्थापयित्वा having made to sit, नदीनदेभ्यः from rivers and rivulets, समन्ततः all together, तीर्थेभ्यश्च from waters, अपः संहृत्य having collected, सर्वेभ्यः from all, समुद्रेभ्यः च and from oceans, विमलम् pure, शुभा auspicious, कनककुम्भेषु in golden pots, निधाय having stored, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभा Sarabha, गन्धमादन Gandhamadana, द्विविदश्चैव and Dvivida, मैन्दश्च Mainda and, हनूमान् Hanuman, नल Nala, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, प्रसन्नेन with pure, सुगन्धिना fragrant, सलिलेन water, शास्त्रदृष्टेन according to sastras, महर्षि विहितेन च aportioned according to the procedure ordained by sages, विधिना as per tradition, शुभैः with auspicious, वृषभशृङ्गैश्च through horns of bulls, काञ्चनैः with golden, कलशैश्चैव pots, वसवः Vasus, सहस्राक्षम् Indra, वासवं यथा like the Indra, अभ्यषिञ्चन्त performed the consecration.

text: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे सर्वे वानर पुंगवाः । प्रचुक्रुशुर् महात्मानो हृष्टाः शत सहस्रशः ॥४-२६-३७॥
translation: As Sugriva was ceremoniously consecrated, thousands of monkeys rejoiced and shrieked out of joy.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवे as Sugriva, अभिषिक्ते was consecrated, सहस्रशः in thousands, सर्वे all, तत्र there, महात्मानः great, वानरपुङ्गवाः leaders among monkeys, हृष्टाः rejoiced, प्रचुक्रुशुः shrieked out of joy.

text: रामस्य तु वचः कुर्वन् सुग्रीवो हरि पुंगवः । अंगदम् संपरिष्वज्य यौवराज्ये अभिषेचयत् ॥४-२६-३८॥
translation: In obedience to Rama's instruction, Sugriva, lord of the monkeys installed Angada as prince regent and embraced him.
word_meanings: हरिपुङ्गवः lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामस्य Rama's, वचः words, कुर्वन् obeying, अङ्गदम् Angada, सम्परिष्वज्य embraced, यौवराज्ये prince regent, अभ्यषेचयत् consecrated.

text: अंगदे च अभिषिक्ते तु सानुक्रोशाः प्लवंगमाः । साधु साधु इति सुग्रीवम् महात्मानो हि अपूजयन् ॥४-२६-३९॥
translation: The great monkeys concerned hailed Sugriva's action saying, 'well done, well done' on the installation of Angada.
word_meanings: अङ्गदे च when Angada also, अभिषिक्ते तु on his consecration, सानुक्रोशाः those who were concerned, महात्मानः great souls, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, साधु साधु well done, well done, इति thus, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभ्यपूजयन् greeted with reverence.

text: रामम् च एव महात्मानम् लक्ष्मणम् च पुनः पुनः । प्रीताः च तुष्टुवुः सर्वे तादृशे तत्र वर्तिनि ॥४-२६-४०॥
translation: As Sugriva and Angada were installed, all the monkeys were highly pleased and praised the noblehearted Rama and Lakshmana again and again.
word_meanings: तत्र there, तादृशे on such an occasion, वर्तिते when it happened, सर्वे all, प्रीताश्च pleased, महात्मानम् great soul, रामं चैव Rama also, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, पुनः पुनः again and again, तुष्टुवुः praised.

text: हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आकीर्णा पताका ध्वज शोभिता । बभूव नगरी रम्या क्षिकिंधा गिरि गह्वरे ॥४-२६-४१॥
translation: The beautiful city of Kishkinda situated in a mountaincave, decorated with banners and flags was filled with happy, wellfed citizens.
word_meanings: गिरिगह्वरे in the mountain cavern, पताकाध्वजशोभिता decorated with banners and flags, रम्या beautiful, किष्किन्धानगरी city of Kishkinda, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा filled with happy welfare citizens, बभूव it looked.

text: निवेद्य रामाय तदा महात्मनेमहा अभिषेकम् कपि वाहनी पतिः । रुमाम् च भार्याम् उपलभ्य वीर्यवान्अवाप राज्यम् त्रिदश अधिपो यथा ॥४-२६-४२॥
अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम् । आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणम् गिरिम् ॥४-२७-१॥
translation: After the consecration, Sugriva entered the cavecity (of Kishkinda) and Rama accompanied by his brother reached mountain Prasravana.
word_meanings: अभिषिक्ते after consecration, वानरे the money, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, गुहाम् cave, प्रविष्टे entered, रामः Rama, भ्रात्रा सह accompanied by his brother, प्रस्रवणं गिरिम् Prasravana mountain, आजगाम arrived.

text: शार्दूल मृग संघुष्टम् सिंहैः भीम रवैः वृतम् । नाना गुल्म लता गूढम् बहु पादप संकुलम् ॥४-२७-२॥
translation: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.
word_meanings: शार्दूलमृगसङ्घुष्टम् filled with sounds of tigers and deer, भीमरवैः roaring in a terrific manner, सिंहैः with lions, वृतम् surrounded with, नानागुल्मलतागूढम् covered with different kinds of shrubs and creepers, बहुपादपसङ्कुलम् full of many kinds of trees, ऋक्षवानरगोपुच्छैः bears, monkeys, and apes, मार्जारैश्च and wild cats, निषेवितम् inhabited, मेघराशिनिभम् like a huge cluster of clouds, नित्यम् always, शुचिजलाश्रमम् ponds of pure water, शैलम् mountain.

text: ऋक्ष वानर गोपुच्छैः मार्जारैः च निषेवितम् । मेघ राशि निभम् शैलम् नित्यम् शुचिकरम् शिवम् ॥४-२७-३॥
translation: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.
word_meanings: शार्दूलमृगसङ्घुष्टम् filled with sounds of tigers and deer, भीमरवैः roaring in a terrific manner, सिंहैः with lions, वृतम् surrounded with, नानागुल्मलतागूढम् covered with different kinds of shrubs and creepers, बहुपादपसङ्कुलम् full of many kinds of trees, ऋक्षवानरगोपुच्छैः bears, monkeys, and apes, मार्जारैश्च and wild cats, निषेवितम् inhabited, मेघराशिनिभम् like a huge cluster of clouds, नित्यम् always, शुचिजलाश्रमम् ponds of pure water, शैलम् mountain.

text: तस्य शैलस्य शिखरे महतीम् आयताम् गुहाम् । प्रत्यगृह्णीत वासार्थम् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह ॥४-२७-४॥
translation: Rama and Lakshmana decided to reside in the long, wide cave on top of the great mountain.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, सौमित्रिणा सह with Saumitri, तस्य शैलस्य mountain's, शिखरे on the top, महतीम् great long, आयताम् wide, गुहाम् cave, वासार्थम् to reside, प्रत्यगृह्णत decided to reside.

text: कृत्वा च समयम् रामः सुग्रीवेण सह अनघ । काल युक्तम् महद् वाक्यम् उवाच रघुनन्दन ॥४-२७-५॥
विनीतम् भ्रातरम् भ्राता लक्ष्मणम् लक्ष्मि वर्धनम् । इयम् गिरि गुहा रम्या विशाला युक्त मारुता ॥४-२७-६॥
translation: Sinless Rama, the delight of the Raghus made an agreement with Sugriva and then spoke appropriately to Lakshmana, his obedient brother and enhancer of glory:
word_meanings: अनघः sinless, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu family, भ्राता brother, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवेण सह समयम् an agreement with Sugriva, कृत्वा after making, विनीतम् him who was obedient, भ्रातरम् to brother, लक्ष्मिवर्धनम् enhancer of glory, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, कालयुक्तम् appropriate for the time, महत् meaningful, वाक्यम् word, उवाच expressed.

text: अस्याम् वस्त्याम सौमित्रे वर्ष रात्रम् अरिंदम । गिरि शृंगम् इदम् रम्यम् उत्तमम् पार्थिवात्मज ॥४-२७-७॥
श्वेताभिः कृष्ण ताम्राभिः शिलाभिः उपशोभितम् । नाना धातु समाकीर्णम् नदी दर्दुर संयुतम् ॥४-२७-८॥
translation: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.
word_meanings: पार्थिवात्मज O prince, श्वेताभिः with white, कृष्णताम्राभिः with black and red, शिलाभिः with stones, उपशोभितम् is very enchanting, नाना धातुसमाकीर्णम् with different kinds of minerals scattered all over, दरीनिर्झरशोभितम् having fascinating caves and waterfalls, विविधैः with different, वृक्षषण्डैश्च with clusters of trees, चारुचित्रलतायुतम् with fascinating vines, नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टम् crowded with different birds, मयूरवरनादितम् with sounds of peacocks, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with bushes of delicate Jasmine and kunda, सिन्धुवारैः sindhuvara flower plants, शिरीषकै: sireeshaka trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, सर्जैश्च and with sarja trees, उपशोभितम् very delighting, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, गिरिशृङ्गम् this peak of mountain, उन्नतम् is lofty.

text: विविधैः वृक्ष षण्डैः च चारु चित्र लता युतम् । नाना विहग संघुष्टम् मयूर वर नादितम् ॥४-२७-९॥
translation: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.
word_meanings: पार्थिवात्मज O prince, श्वेताभिः with white, कृष्णताम्राभिः with black and red, शिलाभिः with stones, उपशोभितम् is very enchanting, नाना धातुसमाकीर्णम् with different kinds of minerals scattered all over, दरीनिर्झरशोभितम् having fascinating caves and waterfalls, विविधैः with different, वृक्षषण्डैश्च with clusters of trees, चारुचित्रलतायुतम् with fascinating vines, नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टम् crowded with different birds, मयूरवरनादितम् with sounds of peacocks, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with bushes of delicate Jasmine and kunda, सिन्धुवारैः sindhuvara flower plants, शिरीषकै: sireeshaka trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, सर्जैश्च and with sarja trees, उपशोभितम् very delighting, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, गिरिशृङ्गम् this peak of mountain, उन्नतम् is lofty.

text: मालती कुंद गुल्मैः च सिंदुवारैः शिरीषकैः । कदंब अर्जुन सर्जैः च पुष्पितैः उपशोभितम् ॥४-२७-१०॥
translation: 'O prince this lovely mountain peak is lofty. It has white, black and red stones with many kinds of minerals scattered all over. It is delightful with caves and streams, and various clusters of trees and variegated vines. The chirps of several kinds of birds as well as the sounds of excellent peacocks are heard here. This place is delightful with bushes of jasmine, kunda and sindhuvara, sireeshaka, kadamba, arjuna and sarja in bloom.
word_meanings: पार्थिवात्मज O prince, श्वेताभिः with white, कृष्णताम्राभिः with black and red, शिलाभिः with stones, उपशोभितम् is very enchanting, नाना धातुसमाकीर्णम् with different kinds of minerals scattered all over, दरीनिर्झरशोभितम् having fascinating caves and waterfalls, विविधैः with different, वृक्षषण्डैश्च with clusters of trees, चारुचित्रलतायुतम् with fascinating vines, नानाविहगसङ्घुष्टम् crowded with different birds, मयूरवरनादितम् with sounds of peacocks, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with bushes of delicate Jasmine and kunda, सिन्धुवारैः sindhuvara flower plants, शिरीषकै: sireeshaka trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, सर्जैश्च and with sarja trees, उपशोभितम् very delighting, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, गिरिशृङ्गम् this peak of mountain, उन्नतम् is lofty.

text: इयम् च नलिनि रम्या फुल्ल पंकज मण्डितैः । न अति दूरे गुहाया नौ भविष्यति नृपात्मज ॥४-२७-११॥
translation: 'O prince this pond with lotus creeper and lotuses in full bloom is endearing. It is located not far from the cave.
word_meanings: नृपात्मज son of a king, फ़ुल्लपङ्कजमण्डिता adorned with lotuses in full bloom, रम्या endearing, इयं नलिनी this lotus creeper, नौ for us, गुहायाः from the cave, नातिदूरे not far from here, भविष्यति is located.

text: प्राग् उदक् प्रवणे देशे गुहा साधु भविष्यति । पश्चात् च एव उन्नता सौम्य निवाते अयम् भविष्यति ॥४-२७-१२॥
translation: 'O goodnatured Lakshmana the descending path on the northeastern side of the cave and elevation on the the west is auspicious.This place is protected from rain water and from strong wind.
word_meanings: सौम्य goodnatured Lakshmana, प्रागुदक्प्रवणे descending path in the northeast, देशे of this place, गुहा cave, साधु auspicious, भविष्यति it will be, पश्चात् west side, उन्नता elevated, इयम् this, निवाता free from strong wind.

text: गुहा द्वारे च सौमित्रे शिला सम तला शिवा । कृष्णा च एव आयता चैव भिन्न अंजन चय उपममा ॥४-२७-१३॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana at the entrance of the cave is a rock, smooth and large, resembling a heap of shining collyrium.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, गुहाद्वारे at the entrance of the cave, समतला even, शुभा good, श्लक्ष्णा smooth, आयताचैव large, भिन्नाञ्जनचयोपमा resembling a heap of shining collyrium, शिला a rock.

text: गिरि शृंगम् इदम् तात पश्य च उत्तरतः सुभम् । भिन्न अंजन चय आकारम् अंभोधरम् इव उदितम् ॥४-२७-१४॥
translation: 'O dear look at the mountain peak in the north rising like a raincloud.It is auspicious. It resembles a heap of collyrium.
word_meanings: तात O dear, उत्तरतः in the north, भिन्नाञ्जनचयाकारम् shaped like a heap of collyrium, उत्थितम् risen, अम्भोधरमिव like a raincloud, शुभम् auspicious, इदम् this, पश्य see, गिरिशृङ्गम् mountain peak, इदम this.

text: दक्षिणस्याम् अपि दिश स्थितम् श्वेतम् इव अंबरम् । कैलास शिखर प्रख्यम् नाना धातु विराजितम् ॥४-२७-१५॥
translation: 'In the southern direction is a white rock appearing as if it is another mountain. It looks like mount Kailas and is rich with various minerals.
word_meanings: दक्षिणस्यांदिशि in the southern direction, स्थितम् is located, श्वेतम् white, इवापरम् like another, कैलासशिखर प्रख्यम् like the tip of Kailasa mountain, नानाधातुविभूषितम् rich with various minerals.

text: प्राचीन वाहिनीम् चैव नदीम् भृशम् अकर्दमम् । गुहायाः परतः पश्य त्रिकूटे जह्नवीम् इव ॥४-२७-१६॥
translation: 'Look at the river flowing towards the east. It has clean water and flows towards the east of the cave and looks like the river Jahnavi flowing on the mount Trikuta. This place looks delightful with the sandalwood, tilaka, sala, tamala, atimukta, padmaka, sarala and asoka trees.
word_meanings: प्राचीनवाहिनीम् flowing towards the east, भृशम् greatly, अकर्दमाम् pure, चन्दनैः with sandalwood, तिलकैः with tilaka, सालैः with sala, तमा tamala, अतिमुक्तकैः with atimuktaka (a lustrous jasmine creeper which sheds flowers profusely), पद्मकैः with Padmaka, सरलैश्चैव with sarala, अशोकैश्चैव and with asoka, शोभिताम् fascinating, त्रिकूटे at Trikuta, जाह्नवीमिव like the river Jahnavi, नदीम् river, गुहायाः from the caves, पूर्वतः to the east, पश्य see.

text: चन्दनैः तिलकैः सालैः तमालैः अतिमुक्तकैः । पद्मकैः सरलैः चैव अशोकैः चैव शोभितम् ॥४-२७-१७॥
translation: 'Look at the river flowing towards the east. It has clean water and flows towards the east of the cave and looks like the river Jahnavi flowing on the mount Trikuta. This place looks delightful with the sandalwood, tilaka, sala, tamala, atimukta, padmaka, sarala and asoka trees.
word_meanings: प्राचीनवाहिनीम् flowing towards the east, भृशम् greatly, अकर्दमाम् pure, चन्दनैः with sandalwood, तिलकैः with tilaka, सालैः with sala, तमा tamala, अतिमुक्तकैः with atimuktaka (a lustrous jasmine creeper which sheds flowers profusely), पद्मकैः with Padmaka, सरलैश्चैव with sarala, अशोकैश्चैव and with asoka, शोभिताम् fascinating, त्रिकूटे at Trikuta, जाह्नवीमिव like the river Jahnavi, नदीम् river, गुहायाः from the caves, पूर्वतः to the east, पश्य see.

text: वानीरैः तिमिदैः चैव वकुलैः केतकैः अपि । हिन्तालैः तिनिशैः नीपैः वेतसैः कृतमालकैः ॥४-२७-१८॥
translation: 'See the different kinds of trees like canes timida, vakula, ketaka, hintala, tinisa, kadamba, dhava, krutamalaka, betasa grown here and there on the bank (of the river), which looks beautiful like a woman decorated with clothes and ornaments.
word_meanings: तीरजैः grown on the bank, नानारूपैः different kinds of, ततस्ततः here and there, वानीरैः with cane reeds, तिमिशै: timis, एव with,वकुलैः vakula,केतकैर्धवै: ketaka, हिन्तालैः hintala, तिनिशैः tinisa, नीपैः (नीपवृक्षैः) kadamba trees, वेत्रकैः cane creepers, धवैः dhavas, कृतमालकैः krutamalaka, वेतसैः betasa, शोभिता beautiful, वसनाभरणोपेता with clothes and ornaments, अभ्यलङ्कृता decorated, प्रमदेव like a woman, भाति looks.

text: तीरजैः शोभिता भाति नाना रूपैः ततः ततः । वसन आभरण उपेत प्रमद एव अभ्यलंकृता ॥४-२७-१९॥
translation: 'See the different kinds of trees like canes timida, vakula, ketaka, hintala, tinisa, kadamba, dhava, krutamalaka, betasa grown here and there on the bank (of the river), which looks beautiful like a woman decorated with clothes and ornaments.
word_meanings: तीरजैः grown on the bank, नानारूपैः different kinds of, ततस्ततः here and there, वानीरैः with cane reeds, तिमिशै: timis, एव with,वकुलैः vakula,केतकैर्धवै: ketaka, हिन्तालैः hintala, तिनिशैः tinisa, नीपैः (नीपवृक्षैः) kadamba trees, वेत्रकैः cane creepers, धवैः dhavas, कृतमालकैः krutamalaka, वेतसैः betasa, शोभिता beautiful, वसनाभरणोपेता with clothes and ornaments, अभ्यलङ्कृता decorated, प्रमदेव like a woman, भाति looks.

text: शतशः पक्षि सन्घैः च नाना नाद विनादिता । एकैकम् अनुरक्तैः च चक्रवाकैः अलंकृता ॥४-२७-२०॥
translation: 'The river flocked with hundreds of birds chirping melodious notes and specially the chakravaka birds which are clinging to their mates in great love are moving in pairs.The river has lovely sandy banks filled with swans and sarasa birds. The river appears as though a young woman decked all over is laughing.
word_meanings: शतशः in hundreds, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च with flocks of birds, नानानादैर्विनादिता resounded with different melodies, एकैकम् each one, अनुरक्तैश्च by the loving ones, चक्रवाकैः by ruddy geese, अलङ्कृता beautified, अतिरम्यैः enchanting, पुलिनैः sandy banks, हंससारससेवितैः filled with swans and watercranes, एषा this, सर्वविभूषिता decorated all over, प्रहसन्ती laughing, नारीव like a young woman, भाति shines.

text: पुलिनैः अति रम्यैः च हंस सारस सेविता । प्रहसंती इव भाति एषा नारी रत्न विभूषिता ॥४-२७-२१॥
translation: 'The river flocked with hundreds of birds chirping melodious notes and specially the chakravaka birds which are clinging to their mates in great love are moving in pairs.The river has lovely sandy banks filled with swans and sarasa birds. The river appears as though a young woman decked all over is laughing.
word_meanings: शतशः in hundreds, पक्षिसङ्घैश्च with flocks of birds, नानानादैर्विनादिता resounded with different melodies, एकैकम् each one, अनुरक्तैश्च by the loving ones, चक्रवाकैः by ruddy geese, अलङ्कृता beautified, अतिरम्यैः enchanting, पुलिनैः sandy banks, हंससारससेवितैः filled with swans and watercranes, एषा this, सर्वविभूषिता decorated all over, प्रहसन्ती laughing, नारीव like a young woman, भाति shines.

text: क्वचित् नीलोत्पलैः च्छन्न भाति रक्तोत्पलैः क्वचित् । क्वचित् भाति शुक्लैः च दिव्यैः कुमुद कुड्मलैः ॥४-२७-२२॥
translation: 'The river looks wonderful with lotuses now blue, now red and now white.
word_meanings: क्वचित् at one place, नीलोत्पलैः with blue lotuses, क्वचित् at another place, रक्तोत्पलैः with red lotuses, छन्ना covered, भाति splendid looking, क्वचित् at some places, शुक्लैश्च with white lotuses, दिव्यैः wonderful, कुमुदकुट्मलैः lotus buds, आभाति appears.

text: पारिप्लव शतैः जुष्टा बर्हि क्रौन्च विनादिता । रमणिया नदी सौम्य मुनि संघ निषेविता ॥४-२७-२३॥
translation: 'This placid river water is haunted by waterbirds, peacocks and kraunchas, It is inhabited by groups of sages.
word_meanings: पारिप्लवशतैः with hundreds of waterbirds, जुष्टा a favoured spot, बर्हिक्रौञ्चविनादिता resounding with peacocks and krauncha birds, मुनिसङ्घैर्निषेविता inhabited by many groups of sages, सौम्या placid, नदी river, रमणीया beautiful.

text: पश्य चंदन वृक्षाणाम् पंक्ती सुरुचिरा इव । ककुभानम् च दृश्यन्ते मनसा इव उदिताः समम् ॥४-२७-२४॥
translation: 'See the uniform rows of sandalwood trees, it looks as though they are arranged together imaginatively.
word_meanings: चन्दनवृक्षाणाम् of sandalwood trees, सुरचिता इव as if arranged, पङ्क्ती: in rows, पश्य see, समम् made uniform, मनसा इव as if imaginatively, उदिताः they have grown, ककुभानां च of the direction, दृश्यन्ते they are seen.

text: अहो सुरमणीयो अयम् देशः शत्रु निषूदन । दृढम् रंस्याव सौमित्रे साधु अत्र निवसावहे ॥४-२७-२५॥
translation: 'O Saumitri destroyer of enemies this place is most enchanting. Surely we will reside here sporting in joy .
word_meanings: शत्रुनिषूदन O destroyer of enemies, सौमित्रे Saumitri, अयम् this, देशः place, सुरमणीयः most enchanting, अहो Oh, अत्र here, साधु well, निवसावहै both will reside, दृढम् surely, रंस्याव we will sport in joy.

text: इतः च न अति दूरे सा किष्किंधा चित्र कानना । सुग्रीवस्य पुरी रम्या भविष्यति नृपात्मज ॥४-२७-२६॥
translation: 'O prince Sugriva's delightful city of Kishkinda with wonderful forest around is not far from here.
word_meanings: नृपात्मज O prince, चित्रकानना wonderful forest, रम्या delightful place, सुग्रीवस्य पुरी Sugriva's city, सा किष्किन्धा Kishkinda, नातिदूरे not far, इत: from here, भविष्यति is located.

text: गीत वादित्र निर्घोषः श्रूयते जयताम् वर । नदताम् वानराणाम् च मृदंग आडंबरैः सह ॥४-२७-२७॥
translation: 'O hero among the victorious, the sounds of vocal and instrumental music, the beating of drums and shrieking of monkeys are heard (from here).
word_meanings: जयतां वर great hero among the victorious, गीतवादित्र निर्घोषः sounds of vocal and musical instruments, नर्दताम् making sounds, वानराणां च of monkeys, मृदङ्गाडम्बरैः सह and beating of drums, श्रूयते is heard.

text: लब्ध्वा भार्याम् कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यम् सुहृत् वृतः । ध्रुवम् नंदति सुग्रीवः संप्राप्य महतीम् श्रियम् ॥४-२७-२८॥
translation: 'Having obtained his wife, his kingdom and attained prosperity the monkey chief, Sugriva will be surely enjoying the company of friends and relatives'.
word_meanings: कपिवरः monkey chief, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भार्याम् wife, लब्ध्वा having obtained, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य having attained, महतीम् very great, श्रियम् prosperity, सम्प्राप्य having earned, सहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends and relatives, नन्दति he is enjoying, ध्रुवम् surely.

text: इति उक्त्वा न्यवसत् तत्र राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः । बहु दृश्य दरी कुंजे तस्मिन् प्रस्रवणे गिरौ ॥४-२७-२९॥
translation: Having said so, Rama resided with Lakshmana on the Prasvarana mountain with many beautiful caverns and shrubs of vines.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said so, बहुदृश्यदरीकुञ्जे in a spot of many caverns and shrubs of vines, तस्मिन् that, प्रस्रवणे गिरौ Prasravana mountain, तत्र there, सहलक्ष्मण: along with Lakshmana, न्यवसत् he resided.

text: सुसुखे हि बहु द्रव्ये तस्मिन् हि धरणी धरे । वसतः तस्य रामस्य रतिः अल्पा अपि न अभवत् ॥४-२७-३०॥
translation: Though Rama was residing in comfort on the mountain richly endowed with many pleasant things, he experienced little happiness.
word_meanings: सुसुखे in comfort, बहुद्रव्ये richly endowed, तस्मिन् in that, धरणीधरे on that mountain, वसतः while residing, तस्य रामस्य for that Rama's, अल्पापि even a little, रतिः pleasure, नाभवत् was not experienced.

text: हृताम् हि भार्याम् स्मरतः प्राणेभ्यो अपि गरीयसीम् । उदय अभ्युदितम् दृष्ट्वा शशांकम् च विशेषतः ॥४-२७-३१॥
translation: Specially with the rising Moon in the east, he remembered his abuducted wife who was dearer to him than his life.
word_meanings: विशेषतः specially, उदयाऽभ्युदितम् rising, शशाङ्कम् Moon, दृष्ट्वा seeing, हृताम् abducted, प्राणेभ्योऽपि more than his life, गरीयसी a very dear lady, भार्याम् wife, स्मरतः remembering.

text: आविवेश न तम् निद्रा निशासु शयनम् गतम् । तत् समुत्थेन शोकेन बाष्प उपहत चेतसम् ॥४-२७-३२॥
translation: As Rama lay in bed, at night, his grief rose and choked him with tears.
word_meanings: तत्समुत्थेन rising, शोकेन by grief, बाष्पोपहतचेतसम् mind befogged with tears, निशासु nights, शयनम् while lying in bed, गतम् gone, तम् he, निद्रा sleep, न आविवेश did not take hold him, निशासु during nights.

text: तम् शोचमानम् काकुत्स्थम् नित्यम् शोक परायणम् । तुल्य दुःखो अब्रवीद् भ्राता लक्ष्मणो अनुनयम् वचः ॥४-२७-३३॥
translation: Seeing Rama worried and engrossed in endless sorrow, his brother Lakshmana who was equally sad spoke these words of consolation:
word_meanings: शोचमानम् who was worried, नित्यम् perpetually, शोकपरायणम् engrossed in sorrow, तम् him, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), अनुनयन् consoling, तुल्यदुःखः an equally sad man, भ्राता brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अलम् वीर व्यथाम् गत्वा न त्वम् शोचितुम् अर्हसि । शोचतो हि अवसीदन्ति सर्व अर्था विदितम् हि ते ॥४-२७-३४॥
translation: 'O heroic one, you know one who broods fails to achieve his objective. So do not brood.
word_meanings: वीर O hero, व्यथाम् pain, गत्वा अलम् stop it, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to worry, न अर्हसि you do not deserve, शोचतः by grieving, सर्वार्थाः all objects, व्यवसीदन्ति हि sink, ते to you, विदितं हि you are aware of this.

text: भवान् क्रिया परो लोके भवान् देव परायणः । आस्तिको धर्म शीलः च व्यवसायी च राघव ॥४-२७-३५॥
translation: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.
word_meanings: अव्यवसितः a man of no enterprise, त्वम् you, विक्रमैः with valiant advances, जिह्मकारिणम् crooked, शत्रुम् enemy, विशेषतः specially, राक्षसम् demon, तम् him, रणे in war, हन्तुम् to slay, समर्थः न हि will not have the capacity, भवान् you, लोके in this world, कियापर a man of action, भवान् you, देवपरायणः devoted to gods, आस्तिक faithful , धर्मशील:च righteous also, व्यवसायी च also enterprising,राघव O Rama.

text: न हि अव्यवसितः शत्रुम् राक्षसम् तम् विशेषतः । समर्थः त्वम् रणे हन्तुम् विक्रमैः जिह्म कारिणम् ॥४-२७-३६॥
translation: 'O Rama you are a man of action, enterprising. You are godfearing, righteous and religious. You will not be able to kill a crooked enemy in a battle, especially a demon, with your valour if you make no endeavour.
word_meanings: अव्यवसितः a man of no enterprise, त्वम् you, विक्रमैः with valiant advances, जिह्मकारिणम् crooked, शत्रुम् enemy, विशेषतः specially, राक्षसम् demon, तम् him, रणे in war, हन्तुम् to slay, समर्थः न हि will not have the capacity, भवान् you, लोके in this world, कियापर a man of action, भवान् you, देवपरायणः devoted to gods, आस्तिक faithful , धर्मशील:च righteous also, व्यवसायी च also enterprising,राघव O Rama.

text: समुन्मूलय शोकम् त्वम् व्यवसायम् स्थिरी कुरु । ततः सपरिवारम् तम् राक्षसम् हन्तुम् अर्हसि ॥४-२७-३७॥
translation: 'Root out sorrow. Be daring. Be firm in resolve. (Only) then can you destroy the demon and his family.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, शोकम् sorrow, समुन्मूलय may uproot, व्यवसायम् daring, स्थिरं कुरु be firm in resolve, ततः then, सपरिवारम् along with all relatives, तं निर्मूलं him destroy, कुरु you do, राक्षसम् that demon.

text: पृथिवीम् अपि काकुत्स्थ ससागर वन अचलाम् । परिवर्तयितुम् शक्तः किम् पुनः तम् हि रावणम् ॥४-२७-३८॥
translation: 'O Kakutstha, you can turn the earth with its oceans, forests and mountains, what to speak of Ravana.
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, ससागरवनाचलाम् with oceans, forests and mountains, पृथिवीमपि the entire earth, परिवर्तयितुम् can turn, शक्तः able, रावणम् that Ravana, किं पुनः what more?

text: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षस्व प्रावृट् कालो अयम् आगतः । ततः स राष्ट्रम् स गणाम् रावणम् तम् वधिष्यसि ॥४-२७-३९॥
translation: 'This is the rainy season.Wait for autumn.Thereafter you will destroy Ravana along with his kingdom and clan.
word_meanings: अयम् this, प्रावृट्कालः rainy season, आगतः has set in, शरत्कालम् autumn, प्रतीक्षस्व you may wait for, ततः then, सराष्ट्रम् along with his country, सगणम् along with his troops, त्वं you, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यसि will slay.

text: अहम् तु खलु ते वीर्यम् प्रसुप्तम् प्रतिबोधये । दीप्तैः आहुतिभिः काले भस्म चन्नम् इव अनलम् ॥४-२७-४०॥
translation: 'I am only awakening your dormant valour as one would kindle the fire covered with ashes by making offerings.'
word_meanings: अहम् I am, काले in proper time, दीप्सैः with smouldering fire, आहुतिभिः with offerings, भस्मच्छन्नम् covered with ashes, अनलम् इव like fire, ते your, प्रसुप्तम् dormant, वीर्यम् courage, प्रतिबोधये खलु I am awakening.

text: लक्ष्मणस्य हि तद् वाक्यम् प्रतिपूज्य हितम् शुभम् । राघवः सुहृदम् स्निग्धम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-२७-४१॥
translation: On hearing the good counsel and auspicious words of Lakshmana, Rama spoke these loving and warm words:
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, हितम् good counsel, शुभम् auspicious, तत् वाक्यम् those words, प्रतिपूज्य respecting, सुहृदम् warm hearted, स्निग्धं loving, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: वाच्यम् यद् अनुरक्तेन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च । सत्य विक्रम युक्तेन तद् उक्तम् लक्ष्मण त्वया ॥४-२७-४२॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana you have spoken the words of an affectionate and friendly counsellor of proven valour.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अनुरक्तेन by an affectionate man, स्निग्धेन by a friendly man, हितेन च by a wellwisher, सत्यविक्रमयुक्तेन by a person endowed with true valour, यत् such, वाच्यम् words said, तत् that, त्वया by you, उक्तम् has been said.

text: एष शोकः परित्यक्तः सर्व कार्य अवसादकः । विक्रमेषु अप्रतिहतम् तेजः प्रोत्साहयामि अहम् ॥४-२७-४३॥
translation: 'This sorrow which dampens one's daring spirit is given up. I shall now resort to such undaunted valour during my heroic exploits.
word_meanings: सर्वकार्यावसादकः which can destroy all work, एषःthis, शोकः sorrow, परित्यक्तः is given up, अहम् I, विक्रमेषु during heroic exploits, अप्रतिहतम् unaffected, तेजः vigour प्रोत्सहयामि I will resort to

text: शरत् कालम् प्रतीक्षिष्ये स्थितो अस्मि वचने तव । सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अनुपालयन् ॥४-२७-४४॥
translation: 'I will wait for autumn. I will stick to your advice while I wait until Sugriva and the rivers are pleased (with moderate flow of water.)
word_meanings: सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, नदीनां च and rivers, प्रसादम् pleasure, अनुपालयन् waiting for, शरत्कालम् for autumn, प्रतीक्षिष्ये I will wait, तव your, वचने words, स्थितः अस्मि resolute.

text: उपकारेण विरः तु प्रतिकारेण युज्यते । अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्ववताम् मनः ॥४-२७-४५॥
translation: A hero requites a benefit with a return of service; but the ungrateful one who repays no favour breaks the heart of the noble-spirited.
word_meanings: उपकारेण with him, वीरः hero, प्रतीकारेण by helping in turn, युज्यते will not fail to do, अकृतज्ञः ungrateful, अप्रतिकृतः one who does not return a favour, सत्त्ववताम् spirited people's, मनः heart, हन्ति destroys.

text: तत् एव युक्तम् प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणःकृत अंजलि तत् प्रतिपूजय भाषितम् । उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम् ॥४-२७-४६॥
translation: Then Lakshmana reflected upon the words of Rama thoughtfully. He honoured his brother's words by receiving his advice with folded hands and spoke to his handsome brother giving out his own views:
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ thereupon, एवम् in this way ,उक्त: told, प्रणिधाय after reflecting thoughtfully, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms in suplication, तत् that, भाषितम् words expresed, प्रतिपूज्य after honouring, आत्मनः his own, शुभम् auspicious, दर्शनम् view, प्रदर्शयन् expressing, स्वभिरामदर्शनम् him who is handsome, रामम् Rama, उवाच said.

text: यथोक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नरेन्द्र कर्ता न चिरात् तु वानर । शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः ॥४-२७-४७॥
translation: 'O lord of men, your desire will be fulfilled soon. Be determined to fight the enemy while waiting for autumn. Forgive this rainy season (and its water that obstructs).
word_meanings: नरेन्द्र king, यथा as, अद्धरीश्वर excellant king, नचिरात् soon, तव your, ईप्सितम् desire, एतत् सर्वम् all this, कर्ता going to do, रिपुनिग्रहे to combat with the enemy, धृतः be determined, भवान् thyself, शरत्प्रतीक्षः waiting for autumn, इमम् this, जलप्रपातम् waterflow, क्षमताम् forgive.

text: नियम्य कोपम् प्रतिपाल्यताम् शरत्क्षमस्व मासाम् चतुरो मया सह । वस अचले अस्मिन् मृग राज सेवितेसंवर्तयन् शत्रु वधे समर्थः ॥४-२७-४८॥
translation: 'Control your anger and wait for autumn. Pardon these (intervening) four months (which put a halt on your wareffort). Stay with me on this mountain infested with lions. Brace up to kill the enemy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: शत्रुवधे in slaying of enemies, समुद्यमम् effort, क्षमस्व you may pardon, कोपम् anger, नियम्य controlling, शरत् autumn, प्रतिपाल्यताम् you may wait for, चतुरः four, मासान् months, संवर्तयन् carrying out, मृगराजसेविते inhabited by lions, अस्मिन् अचले on this mountain, मया सह along with me, वस stay.

text: स तदा वालिनम् हत्वा सुग्रीवम् अभिषिच्य च । वसन् माल्यवतः पृष्टे रामो लक्ष्मणम् अब्रवीत् ॥४-२८-१॥
translation: After the killing of Vali and installation of Sugriva as king, Rama arrived at mountain Malyavan to reside.He said to Lakshmana:
word_meanings: वालिनम् Vali, हत्वा killed, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभिषिच्य installed, तदा then, माल्यवतः mountain Malyavan, पृष्ठे on, वसन् reside, सः रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: अयम् स कालः संप्राप्तः समयो अद्य जल आगमः । संपश्य त्वम् नभो मेघैः संवृतम् गिरि संनिभैः ॥४-२८-२॥
translation: 'Now that the rainy season has started, see the sky covered with mountainlike (huge) clouds.
word_meanings: सः अयम् this, कालः time, सम्प्राप्तः started, अद्य now, जलागमः समयः time of rainy season, गिरिसन्निभैः like mountains, मेघैः by clouds, संवृतम् covered, नभः sky, त्वम् you, सम्पश्य see.

text: नव मास धृतम् गर्भम् भास्करस्य गभस्तिभिः । पीत्वा रसम् समुद्राणाम् द्यौः प्रसूते रसायनम् ॥४-२८-३॥
translation: 'The sky has drained the water from the oceans through the Sun's rays and has borne it for nine months (from Kartika to Asarha) in its womb. It delivers water which is the base for all juices.
word_meanings: द्यौः sky, भास्करस्य Sun's, गभस्तिभिः with rays of sunlight, समुद्राणाम् from oceans, रसम् water, पीत्वा drunk, नवमासधृतम् borne for nine months, रसायनम् the base for all juices, गर्भम् womb, प्रसूते is delivering.

text: शक्यम् अंबरम् आरुह्य मेघ सोपान पंक्तिभिः । कुटज अर्जुन मालाभिः अलंकर्तुम् दिवाकरम् ॥४-२८-४॥
translation: 'It is possible to climb up to the sky on the stairs formed by the clouds and decorate the Sungod with garlands made of kutaja and arjuna flowers.
word_meanings: मेघसोपानपङ्क्तिभिः by the stairway of clouds, अम्बरम् sky, आरुह्य climbing, दिवाकरम् Sun, कुटजार्जुनमालाभिः with garlands of kutaja and arjuna flowers, अलङ्कर्तुम् to decorate, शक्यम् is possible.

text: संध्या राग उत्थितैः ताम्रैः अंतेषु अधिक पाण्डुरैः । स्निग्धैः अभ्र पट च्छेदैः बद्ध व्रणम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-५॥
translation: 'The sky looks as though its wounds are dressed with pale white moistureladen bandage cloths of clouds, red in the border, tinged as they are with the glow of twilight.
word_meanings: सन्ध्यारागोत्थितैः owing to the touch of the radiance of the evening Sun, ताम्रैः with red colour, अन्तेष्वधिक in the tinge, पाण्डुरैः with pale white colour, स्निग्धैः shining, अभ्रपटच्छेदैः pieces of cloth of clouds, अम्बरम् sky, बद्धव्रणम् इव appears like a bandaged wound.

text: मन्द मारुत निःश्वासम् संध्या चंदन रंजितम् । आपाण्डु जलदम् भाति काम आतुरम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-६॥
translation: 'The sky with its gentle winds as its sighs, its ash coloured clouds (suggestive of a pale face) painted with red sandalpaste in the form of glow of twilight appears like a passionate lover.
word_meanings: मन्दमारुतनिश्वासम् sighing with gentle winds, सन्ध्याचन्दनरञ्जितम् reddened with sandalpaste of evening twilight, आपाण्डुजलदम् with ashcoloured clouds, अम्बरम् sky, भाति appears, कामातुरं passionate lover.

text: एषा घर्म परिक्लिष्टा नव वारि परिप्लुता । सीता इव शोक संतप्ता मही बाष्पम् विमुंचति ॥४-२८-७॥
translation: 'This earth scorched by the heat and then flooded with fresh rain water, radiating heat, appears like my Sita shedding tears burning with grief.
word_meanings: घर्मपरिक्लिष्टा scorched by the heat, नववारिपरिप्लुता flooded with fresh rain water, एषा मही the earth that way, शोकसन्तप्ता burning with grief, सीतेव like Sita, बाष्पम् tears, विमुञ्चति is shedding.

text: मेघ उदर विनिर्मुक्ताः कर्पूर दल शीतलाः । शक्यम् अंजलिभिः पातुम् वाताः केतकि गन्धिनः ॥४-२८-८॥
translation: 'The winds released from the wombs of clouds, cool as the delicate touch of white lotuses,charged with the fragrance of ketaka flowers can be inhaled through the hollow of one's palms.
word_meanings: मेघोदरविनिर्मुक्ताः released from the womb of clouds, कह्लारसुखशीतलाः gentle and cool as white lotuses, केतकिगन्धिनः carrying the fragrance of Kethaka flowers, वाताः winds, अञ्जलिभिः with cupped palms also, पातुम् for drinking, शक्यम् possible.

text: एष फुल्ल अर्जुनः शैलः केतकैः अधिवासितः । सुग्रीव इव शान्त अरिः धाराभिः अभिषिच्यते ॥४-२८-९॥
translation: 'This mountain scented by the fragrance of arjuna and ketaka flowers is bathed in rain water just as Sugriva, tranquilled by the destruction of the enemy is consecrated in streams of (sacred) waters.
word_meanings: फुल्लार्जुनः arjuna flowers, केतकैः ketaka flowers, अधिवासितः filled with fragrance, एषः शैलः this mountain that way, शान्तारिः tranquilled by the destruction of enemy, सुग्रीव इव like Sugriva, धाराभिः with flowing water, अभिषिच्यते is consecrated.

text: मेघ कृष्ण अजिन धरा धारा यज्ञ उपवीतिनः । मारुत आपूरित गुहाः प्राधीता इव पर्वताः ॥४-२८-१०॥
translation: 'The mountains are covered with dark clouds which appear like the hide of the antelope. Streams of rain water flowing are like the sacred threads hanging down the shoulder and the sounds of wind filling the caves resemble the recitation of Vedas by priests. (These mountains are comparable to the brahmacharins engaged in the recitation of Vedas wearing antelopeskin and sacred threads).
word_meanings: मेघकृष्णाजिनधराः clouds of the colour of black antelope skin, धारायज्ञोपवीतिनः streams of water falling like sacred threads, मारुतापूरितगुहाः winds in caves, पर्वताः mountain, प्राधीता इव like priests reciting (mantras).

text: कशाभिः इव हैमीभिः विद्युद्भिः इव ताडितम् । अन्तः स्तनित निर्घोषम् सवेदनम् इव अंबरम् ॥४-२८-११॥
translation: 'The sky lashed with lightnings with whips of gold and emitting groans in the form of peals of thunder, appears as though crying in severe pain.
word_meanings: हैमीभिः by the golden, कशाभिरिव whips, विद्युद्भि: by the lightnings, ताडितम् lashed, स्तनित thunder, निर्घोषम् sounds, अम्बरम् sky, अन्तः inside, सवेदनमिव as if crying in severe pain.

text: नील मेघ आश्रिता विद्युत् स्फुरंती प्रतिभाति मे । स्फुरंती रावणस्य अंके वैदेही इव तपस्विनी ॥४-२८-१२॥
translation: 'The triggering of lightning in the dark clouds appears to me like austere Vaidehi struggling helplessly to get free from the lap of Ravana.
word_meanings: नीलमेघाश्रिता coverd with dark clouds, स्फुरन्ती triggering looks like, विद्युत् lightning, रावणस्य Ravana's, अङ्के from the lap, स्फुरन्ती struggling, तपस्विनी pitiable woman, वैदेहीव like Vaidehi, मा to me, प्रतिभाति appears.

text: इमाः ता मन्मथवताम् हिताः प्रतिहता दिशः । अनुलिप्ता इव घनैः नष्ट ग्रह निशा कराः ॥४-२८-१३॥
translation: 'Smeared as it were with dense clouds and therefore blocked the directions in which planets including the Moon cease to appear are favourable to lovers. The Moon is said to accenuate the pangs of separation from one's ladylove. Hence the quarters in which the Moon and the stars are hidden by clouds, have been favourable to the lovelorn.
word_meanings: मन्मथवताम् for the lovers, हिताः favourable, प्रतिहताः blocked, नष्टग्रहनिशाकराः Moon or planets seized to appear, इमाः this, ताः दिशः directions, घनैः with dense clouds, अनुलिप्ता इव as if smeared.

text: क्वचित् बाष्प अभिसंरुद्धान् वर्ष आगम समुत्सुकान् । कुटजान् पश्य सौमित्रे पुष्टितान् गिरि सानुषु । मम शोक अभिभूतस्य काम सम्दीपनान् स्थितान् ॥४-२८-१४॥
translation: 'O Saumitri look at the kutaja flowers standing on the mountain slopes withered by the heat. They welcome the fresh showers of rain and rekindle passion in me even though my heart is overwhelmed with grief.
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, क्वचित् at some places, बाष्पाभिसंरुद्धान् withered in the heat of water vapour, वर्षागमसमुत्सुकान् welcome the fresh showers of rain, गिरिसानुषु on slop of mountains, स्थितान् standing, पुष्पितान् bloomed, शोकाभिभूतस्य overwhelmed with grief, मम my, कामसन्दीपनान् kindling my love, कुटजान् kutaja trees, पश्य see.

text: रजः प्रशांतम् स हिमो अद्य वायुःनिदाघ दोष प्रसराः प्रशांताः । स्थिता हि यात्रा वसुधा अधिपानाम्प्रवासिनो यांति नराः स्व देशान् ॥४-२८-१५॥
translation: 'Now the dust has settled and the wind carrying mist is cool. The torments of summer have ceased. The expeditions of kings have come to a stop and the travellers return to their native land.
word_meanings: अद्य now, रजः dust, प्रशान्तम् has settled, वायुः wind, सहिमः blowing with mist, निदाघदोषप्रसराः torments of the heat of summer, प्रशान्ताः pacified, वसुधाधिपानाम् lords of earth, यात्रा expeditions, स्थिता हि is stopped, प्रवासिनः the travellers far off, नराः men, स्वदेशान् to their own land, यान्ति reach.

text: संप्रस्थिता मानस वास लुब्धाःप्रिय अन्विताः संप्रति चक्रवाकः । अभीक्ष्ण वर्ष उदक विक्षतेषुयानानि मार्गेषु न संपतन्ति ॥४-२८-१६॥
translation: 'Desirous of living in Manasa lake swans have set out on their journey and the chakravaka birds are now united with their mates. The carts move not on the roads damaged by heavy rains.
word_meanings: सम्प्रति presently, मानसवासलुब्धाः desiring to live in Manasa lake, सम्प्रस्थिताः started their journey, चक्रवाकाः the chakravakas, प्रियान्विताः united with their loved ones, अभीक्ष्णवर्षोदकविक्षतेषु damaged by heavy rains, मार्गेषु on the roads, यानानि carts, न सम्पतन्ति not move out.

text: क्वचित् प्रकाशम् क्वचिद् अप्रकाशम्नभः प्रकीर्णा अंबु धरम् विभाति । क्वचित् क्वचित् पर्वत संनिरुद्धम्रूपम् यथा शान्त महार्णवस्य ॥४-२८-१७॥
translation: 'The sky which is visible here is not visible there due to clouds scattered. It looks bright (blue) here and dull there. It appears like an unruffled ocean interspersed with hills here and there.
word_meanings: प्रकीर्णाम्बुधरम् clouds scattered all over the sky, क्वचित् in some place, प्रकाशम् flashing, क्वचित् at some other place, अप्रकाशम् dull, नभः the sky, क्वचित्क्वचित् here and there, पर्वतसन्निरुद्धम् obstructed by mountains, शान्तमहार्णवस्य like unruffled ocean, रूपं यथा appearing like that, विभाति glowing

text: व्यामिश्रितम् सर्ज कदंब पुष्पैःनवम् जलम् पर्वत धातु ताम्रम् । मयूर केकाभिः अनुप्रयातम्शैल अपगाः शीघ्रतरम् वहन्ति ॥४-२८-१८॥
translation: 'The mountainstreams of rainwater mingled with sarja and kadamba flowers carry fresh water swiftly to the ocean along with the deposits of red mineral rocks of the mountain. Hark, the peacock cries.
word_meanings: शैलापगाः streams of water from the mountains, सार्जकदम्बपुष्पैः with sarja and kadamba blossoms, व्यामिश्रितम् combined with, पर्वतधातुताम्रम् red with minerals of the mountain, मयूरकेकाभिः cries of peacocks, अनुप्रयातम् accompany, नवं जलम् fresh rain water, शीघ्रतरम् swiftly, वहन्ति flow.

text: रस आकुलम् षट्पद संनिकाशम्प्रभुज्यते जंबु फलम् प्रकामम् । अनेक वर्णम् पवन अवधूतम्भूमौ पतति आम्र फलम् विपक्वम् ॥४-२८-१९॥
translation: 'The black bees like jambu fruits full of sweet juice. People share them to their hearts content, while the mango fruits which take multiple colours on getting ripened drop on the ground shaken by the wind.
word_meanings: रसाकुलम् very juicy, षट्पदसन्निकाशम् like the black bee, जम्बुफलम् jambu fruit, प्रकामम् to the heart's content, प्रभुज्यते are eaten, अनेकवर्णम् of multiple colours, विपक्वम् fully ripened, आम्रफलम् mango fruit, पवनावधूतम् shaken by the wind, भूमौ on the ground, पतति fall.

text: विद्युत् पताकाः स बलाक मालाःशैलेन्द्र कूट आकृति संनिकाशाः । गर्जन्ति मेघाः समुदीर्ण नादामत्त गजेन्द्रा इव संयुगस्थाः ॥४-२८-२०॥
translation: The clouds that resemble high mountain peaks, having their banners of lightning with rows of herons as garlands give out loud peals of thunder like elephants in rut trumpet in battlearray.
word_meanings: विद्युत्पताकाः with banners of lightning, सबलाकमालाः closely connected garlands (rows) of herons, शैलेन्द्रकूटाकृतिसन्निकाशाः resembling the shapes of high mountain peaks, मेघाः clouds, संयुगस्थाः marching in wars, मत्ताः proud, गजेन्द्रा इव resembling elephants, समुदीर्णनादाः trumpetting in excitement, गर्जन्ति rumble.

text: वर्ष उदक आअप्यायित शाद्वलानिप्रवृत्त नृत्त उत्सव बर्हिणानि । वनानि निर्वृष्ट बलाहकानिपश्य अपराह्णेषु अधिकम् विभान्ति ॥४-२८-२१॥
translation: 'The tender green grass of the forest is shining with rainwater, the peacocks are having dance festival and the forests look more enchanting in the afternoon.
word_meanings: वर्षोदकाप्यायितशाद्वलानि the tender green grass shining with rain waters, प्रवृत्तनृत्तोत्सवबर्हिणानि filled with peacocks starting the dance festival, निर्वृष्टवलाहकानि when the clouds have shed all their rain water, वनानि forests, अपराह्णेषु in the afternoon, अधिकम् more, विभान्ति enchanting, पश्य see.

text: सम् उद् वहन्तः सलिल अति भारम्बलाकिनो वारि धरा नदन्तः । महत्सु शृंगेषु मही धराणाम्विश्रम्य विश्रम्य पुनः प्रयान्ति ॥४-२८-२२॥
translation: 'The huge rumbling clouds on the high mountain peaks carry heavy load of water. Now they rest and now resume their journey accompanied by herons.
word_meanings: सलिलातिभारम् heavy loads of water, समुद्वहन्तः while carrying, बलाकिनः accompanied by cranes, वारिधराः clouds, नदन्तः while thundering, महीधराणाम् of mountains, महत्सु on the high, शृङ्गेषु on peaks, विश्रम्य after resting, विश्रम्य halting again, पुनः again, प्रयान्ति move.

text: मेघ अभिकामा परिसंपतन्तीसम्मोदिता भाति बलाक पंक्तिः । वात अवधूता वर पौण्डरीकीलंब इव माला रुचिर अंबरस्य ॥४-२८-२३॥
translation: 'The happy rows of herons flying in the sky to meet the clouds, appear like a long garland of choice white lotuses strung together hanging in the sky.
word_meanings: मेघाभिकामा longing for clouds, परिसम्पतन्ती flying along, सम्मोदिता rejoiced, बलाकपङ्क्ति: row of cranes, अम्बरस्य in the sky, वातावधूता shaken by the wind, वरपौण्डरीकी of the choice white lotuses, रचिता strung, लम्बा hanging, माला इव resemling garlands, भाति appears.

text: बाल इन्द्रगोप्ता अंतर चित्रितेनविभाति भूमिः नव शाद्वलेन । गात्र अनुपृक्तेन शुक प्रभेणनारी इव लाक्ष उक्षित कंबलेन ॥४-२८-२४॥
translation: 'The earth shines with freshgrown, tender grass speckled here and there with small Indragopa insects. It appears like a woman wearing a parrotgreen veil sprinkled with red lac dye.
word_meanings: बालेन्द्रगोपान्तरचित्रितेन dotted with small Indragopa insects, नवशाद्वलेन with fresh grass, भूमिः ground, गात्रानुपृक्तेन touching their body, शुकप्रभेण with parrot green,लाक्षोक्षितकम्बलेन with a veil dotted with redlac dye sprinkled on it, नारीव like a lady, विभाति is shining.

text: निद्रा शनैः केशवम् अभ्युपैतिद्रुतम् नदी सागरम् अभ्युपैति । हृष्टा बलाका घनम् अभ्युपैतिकान्ता स कामा प्रियम् अभ्युपैति ॥४-२८-२५॥
translation: 'Sleep steals over Lord Visnu. The rivers run swiftly to the sea, the female herons fly to catch the clouds joyfully. The young bride eagerly approaches her dear lord. (It is believed that Lord Visnu goes to sleep during chaturmasya, ie. from Asarh to Kartik)
word_meanings: निद्रा sleep, शनैः slowly, केशवम् Lord Visnu, अभ्युपैति steals over, नदी river, द्रुतम् swiftly, सागरम् sea, अभ्युपैति approaches, हृष्टा joyfully, बलाका crane, घनम् cloud, अभ्युपैति approaches, सकामा filled with passion, कान्ता woman, प्रियम् beloved, अभ्युपैति approaches.

text: जाता वनान्ताः शिखि सुप्रनृत्ताजाताः कदंबाः स कदंब शाखाः । जाता वृषा गोषु समान कामाजाता मही सस्य वन अभिरामा ॥४-२८-२६॥
translation: 'Peacocks dance in the forest. The branches of the kadamba trees get filled with flowers. Bulls long for union with the cows. The earth looks beautiful with green crops and trees.
word_meanings: वनान्ताः the forest regions, शिखिसम्प्रनृत्ताः peacocks dancing, जाताः have started, कदम्बाः kadamba trees, सकदम्बशाखाः branches of kadamba trees, जाताः started bloomimg, वृषाः mighty bulls, गोषु with cows, समानकामाः equally desiring, जाताः have become, मही earth, सस्यवनाभिरामा filled with lovely green crops and trees.

text: वहन्ति वर्षन्ति नदन्ति भान्तिध्यायन्ति नृत्यन्ति समाश्वसन्ति । नद्यो घना मत्त गजा वन अन्ताःप्रिया विहीनाः शिखिनः प्लवंगाः ॥४-२८-२७॥
translation: 'The clouds are raining. The rivers are flowing. Proud elephants are trumpeting. Those separated from their loved ones are brooding. The monkeys are quiet and the peacocks are dancing.
word_meanings: नद्यः rivers, घनाः clouds, मत्तगजाः proud elephants, वनान्ताः forest lands, प्रियाविहीनाः away from their loved ones, शिखिनः peacocks, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, वहन्ति are flowing, वर्षन्ति are raining, नदन्ति are trumpeting, भान्ति are shining, ध्यायन्ति contemplating, नृत्यन्ति dancing, समाश्वसन्ति are quietened.

text: प्रहर्षिताः केतक पुष्प गन्धम्आघ्राय मत्ता वन निर्झरेषु । प्रपात शब्द आकुलिता गजेन्द्राःसार्धम् मयूरैः स मदा नदन्ति ॥४-२८-२८॥
translation: 'The lordly elephants get intoxicated with the fragrance of ketaki flowers, the noise of waterfalls and the cackle of peacocks and they give out a shrill trumpet.
word_meanings: केतकपुष्पगन्धम् fragrance of Ketaki flowers, आघ्राय enjoying the smell, प्रहर्षिताः joyously, गजेन्द्राः elephants, मत्ताः lordly, वननिर्झरेषु in the waterfalls, प्रपातशब्दाः disturbed by the sound of water falling, समदाः intoxicated ones, मयूरैः सार्धम् with peacocks,नदन्ति trumpet.

text: धारा निपातैः अभिहन्यमानाःकदंब शाखासु विलंबमानाः । क्षण अर्जितम् पुष्प रस अवगाढम्शनैर् मदम् षट् चरणाः त्यजन्ति ॥४-२८-२९॥
translation: 'Having sucked honey from the flowercups filled with honey, the bees are shedding their drunkenness slowly and hanging on the branches of kadamba trees, smitten with showers.
word_meanings: धारानिपातैः with the flow of rainwater, अभिहन्यमानाः beaten, कदम्बशाखासु on the branches of kadamba trees, विलम्बमानाः hanging over, षट्चरणाः bees, क्षणार्जितम् acquired in a moment, पुष्परसावगाढम् sucking the honey from the flowers, मदम् strong smell, शनैः slowly, त्यजन्ति leave.

text: अंगार चूर्ण उत्कर संनिकाशैःफलैः सुपर्याप्त रसैः समृद्धैः । जंबू द्रुमाणाम् प्रविभान्ति शाखानिपीयमाना इव षट्पद ओघैः ॥४-२८-३०॥
translation: 'The branches of jambu trees profusely filled with fruits appear like piled up balls of charcoal, while swarms of bees rest on the branches on the jambu trees.
word_meanings: अङ्गारचूर्णोत्करसन्निकाशैः appearing like piled up balls of charcoal, फलैस्सुपर्याप्तरसै: filled with abundance of juice, समृद्धैः rich, जम्बूद्रुमाणां of jambu trees, प्रविभान्ति shining, शाखा: branches, निलीयमाना इव reclining,षट्पदौघैः by swarm of bees.

text: तडित् पताकाभिः अलंकृतानाम्उदीर्ण गंभीर महा रवाणाम् । विभान्ति रूपाणि बलाहकानाम्रण उत्सुकानाम् इव वारणानाम् ॥४-२८-३१॥
translation: 'The rainclouds decorated with banners of lightning and giving out peals of thunder shine like elephants in rut trumpeting, eager to fight in battle.
word_meanings: तटित्पताकाभिः banners of lightning, अलङ्कृतानाम् of the decorated, उदीर्णगम्भीरमहारवाणाम् making loud sound, वलाहकानाम् of the thundering clouds, रूपाणि forms, रणोत्सुकानाम् ready to fight in battle, वानराणाम् इव like elephants in rut, विभान्ति shine.

text: मार्ग अनुगः शैल वन अनुसारीसंप्रस्थितो मेघ रवम् निशम्य । युद्ध अभिकामः प्रतिनाद शन्कीमत्तो गजेन्द्रः प्रतिसंनिवृत्तः ॥४-२८-३२॥
translation: 'Intoxicated elephants on their march along the mountain in the forest, hear the thundering sounds of clouds and suspecting it to be the call of proud elephants to fight turn back.
word_meanings: मेघरवम् thunder of clouds, निशम्य heard, प्रतिनादशङ्की suspected it to be the sound of the enemy, युद्धाभिकामः desirous of waging war, सम्प्रस्थितः started to go, मार्गानुगः following the way, शैलवनानुसारी following the trees of the forest along the mountain, मत्तः proud, गजेन्द्रः elephant, प्रतिसन्निवृत्तः turned back.

text: क्वचित् प्रगीता इव षट्पद ओघैःक्वचित् प्रवृत्ता इव नील कण्ठैः । क्वचित् प्रमत्ता इव वारण इन्द्रैःविभाति अनेक आश्रयिणो वनान्ता ॥४-२८-३३॥
translation: 'Swarms of bees hum here. Peacocks dance there. Intoxicated elephants sport in water in other places. (Thus) the forest shows its many features.
word_meanings: अनेकाश्रयिणः supporting many, वनान्ताः forestland, क्वचित् in some places, षट्पदौघैः with swarms of bees, प्रगीताः इव humming, क्वचित् in some regions, नीलकण्ठै: with peacocks, प्रनृत्ता इव as if dancing, क्वचित् at some place, वारणेन्द्रैः by the elephants, प्रमत्ताः इव like the intoxicated ones, विभान्ति were shining.

text: कदंब सर्जा अर्जुन कंदल आढ्यावनान्त भूमि मधु वारि पूर्णा । मयूर मत्ता अभिरुत प्रवृत्तैःअपान भूमि प्रतिमा विभाति ॥४-२८-३४॥
translation: 'The forest region with its various types of trees like kadamba, sarja and arjuna trees and full of fresh water shines like a tavern where girls in the form of peahens dance in excitement.
word_meanings: कदम्बसर्जार्जुनकन्दलाढ्याः rich with the shoots of kadamba, sarja, arjuna trees, नववारिपूर्णा filled with fresh rain water, वनान्तभूमिः the forestland, मयूरमत्ताभिरुतप्रनृत्तै: sounds and dances of intoxicated peahens, विभाति shines, आपानभूमिप्रतिमा like a tavern.

text: मुक्ता समाभम् सलिलम् पतत् वैसुनिर्मलम् पत्र पुटेषु लग्नम् । हृष्टा विवर्ण च्छदना विहंगाःसुरेन्द्र दत्तम् तृषिताः पिबन्ति ॥४-२८-३५॥
translation: 'Thirsty birds rejoice drinking exceedingly pure water held in leafcups offered by Indra (in the form of rain), which looks like pearls collected in the leafcups. As the drops fall on them the hue of their wings seems to change (fade).
word_meanings: सुरेन्द्रदत्तम् offered by lord of gods, Indra, मुक्तासकाशम् like pearls, पतत् while falling, सुनिर्मलम् exceedingly pure, पत्रपुटेषु in leaf cups, लग्नम् collected, सलिलम् water, तृषिताः thirsty ones, विवर्णच्छदनाः with faded wings, विहङ्गाः birds, हृष्टाः rejoice, पिबन्ति are drinking.

text: षत्पद तंत्री मधुर अभिधानम्प्लवंगम् उदीरित कण्ठ तालम् । आविष्कृतम् मेघ मृदंग नादैःवनेषु संगीतम् इव प्रवृत्तम् ॥४-२८-३६॥
translation: 'The sweet humming of bees like the music of string instruments (Vina), the croaking of frogs, the rumbling of clouds sounding like the beating of drums make it appear as if a musical concert has started in the forest.
word_meanings: वनेषु in the forest, षट्पादतन्त्रीमधुराभिधानम् the sweet humming bees like the music of string instruments, प्लवङ्गमोदीरितकण्ठतालम् the croaking of frogs, मेघमृदङ्गनादैः rumbling of clouds like beating of drums, आविष्कृतम् started, सङ्गीतम् musical concert, प्रवृत्तम् इव as if commenced.

text: क्वचित् प्रनृत्तैः क्वचित् उन् नदद्भिःक्वचित् च वृक्ष अग्र निषण्ण कायैः । व्यालंब बर्ह आभरणैः मयूरैःवनेषु संगितम् इव प्रवृत्तम् ॥४-२८-३७॥
translation: 'Here the peacocks are dancing and there they are singing. Elsewhere they are reclining on treetops with their big plumage hanging down. It appears as though the peacocks have started a musical concert in the forest.
word_meanings: क्वचित् at some location, प्रनृत्तै: by those engaged in dancing, क्वचित् at some place, उन्नदद्भिः making sounds, क्वचित् at some place, वृक्षाग्रनिषण्णकायैः by those settled on the tree tops, व्यालम्बबर्हाभरणैः by those adorned with a big plumage hanging at their back, वनेषु in the forest, मयूरैः peacocks, सङ्गीतम् like musical concert, प्रवृत्तम् इव as though engaged.

text: स्वनैः घनानाम् प्लवगाः प्रबुद्धाविहाय निद्राम् चिर संनिरुद्धाम् । अनेक रूपा आकृति वर्ण नादानव अंबु धारा अभिहता नदन्ति ॥४-२८-३८॥
translation: 'Frogs of different forms, colours and sounds are croaking, awakened from their long sleep by the thunders of clouds and flow of fresh rainwater.
word_meanings: घनानाम् of the clouds, स्वनैः sounds, प्रबुद्धाः awakened, अनेकरूपाकृतिवर्णनादाः in different forms, colours and sounds, प्लवगाः frogs, चिरसन्निरुद्धाम् preventing for a long time, निद्राम् sleep, विहाय giving up, नवाम्बुधाराभिहताः by the flow of rain waters, नदन्ति croaking.

text: नद्यः समुद्वाहित चक्रवाकातटानि शीर्णानि अपवाहयित्वा । दृप्ता नव प्राभृत पूर्ण भोगाद्रुतम् स्व भर्तारम् उपोप यान्ति ॥४-२८-३९॥
translation: 'Washing away their broken banks which obstruct their way to the sea, the bloated rivers like proud young ladies with chakravaka birds borne on their surface ,which look like protruberant breasts, rush swiftly to meet their lord, the sea, chosen for full enjoyment with the gifts of flowers.
word_meanings: समुद्वाहितचक्रवाकाः carrying the chakravaka birds, दृप्ताः bloated with pride, नद्यः rivers, शीर्णानि broken, तटानि banks, अपवाहयित्वा avoiding, नवप्राभृतपूर्णभोगाः enjoying fully with their new gifts, स्वभर्तारम् their lord (sea), द्रुतम् swiftly, उपोपयान्ति approaching.

text: नीलेषु नीला नव वारि पूर्णामेघेषु मेघाः प्रविभान्ति सक्ताः । दवाग्नि दग्धेषु दवाग्नि दग्धाःशैलेषु शैला इव बद्ध मूलाः ॥४-२८-४०॥
translation: 'Dark clouds filled with fresh water, leaning on dark clouds appear like boulders of rock, scorched with wild fire with their bases yet firmly rooted shining.
word_meanings: नीलेषु dark, मेघेषु clouds, सक्ताः leaned, नववारिपूर्णाः full of fresh water, नीलाः dark, मेघाः clouds, दवाग्निदग्देषु burnt by forest fire, शैलेषु mountain, बद्धमूलाः yet firmly rooted, दवाग्निदग्धाः consumed by wild fire, शैलाः mountains, इव like, प्रतिभान्ति shining.

text: प्रमत्त संनाददित बर्हिणानिस शक्रगोप अकुल शाद्वलानि । चरन्ति नीप अर्जुन वासितानिगजाः सुरम्याणि वन अन्तराणि ॥४-२८-४१॥
translation: 'Elephants roam the forestland inhabited by peacocks making noise out of joy, where the grassy land is filled with crawling Indragopa insects and the fragrance of kadamba and arjuna blossoms.
word_meanings: गजाः elephants, प्रहृष्टसन्नादितबर्हिणानि peacocks making noise out of joy, सशक्रगोपाकुलशाद्वलानि filled with Indragopa insects crawling on young grass beds, नीपार्जुनवासितानि giving out smell of kadamba and arjuna blossoms, सुरम्याणि delightful, वनान्तराणि forestland, चरन्ति roam about.

text: नव अंबु धार आहत केसराणिद्रुतम् परित्यज्य सरोरुहाणि । कदंब पुष्पाणि स केसराणिनवानि हृष्टा भ्रमराः पिबन्ति ॥४-२८-४२॥
translation: 'The bees have quit the lotus filaments destroyed by the rain and happily move quickly towards fresh filaments of kadamba flowers.
word_meanings: हृष्टाः delighted, भ्रमराः honeybees, नवाम्बुधाराहतकेसराणि with filaments destroyed by rain, सरोरुहाणि lotuses, द्रुतम् quickly, परित्यज्य leaving, सकेसराणि fresh filaments, नवानि new, कदम्बपुष्पाणि kadamba flowers, दृष्ट्वा seeing, पतन्ति falling.

text: मत्ता गजेन्द्रा मुदिता गवेन्द्रावनेषु विक्रांततरा मृगेन्द्राः । रम्या नगेन्द्रा निभृता नरेन्द्राःप्रक्रीडितो वारि धरैः सुरेन्द्रः ॥४-२८-४३॥
translation: 'Intoxicated elephants roam the forest. Mighty bulls rejoice. Kings of beasts (lions) lounge. Mountains look beautiful. Kings relax. While Indra, lord of the gods, sports with clouds.
word_meanings: गजेन्द्राः elephants, मत्ताः proud, वनेषु in the forest, गवेन्द्राः proud bulls, मुदिताः are happy, मृगेन्द्राः king of animals, विश्रान्ततराः are taking rest, नगेन्द्राः mountains, रम्याः beautiful, नरेन्द्राः kings, निभृताः not moving, सुरेन्द्र: lord of gods, वारिधरैः with clouds, प्रक्रीडितः sporting.

text: मेघाः समुद् भूत समुद्र नादामहाजल ओघैः गगन अवलंबाः । नदीः तटाकानि सरांसि वापिःमहीम् च कृत्स्नाम् अपवाहयन्ति ॥४-२८-४४॥
translation: 'With their big torrents, clouds hanging over the sky, drowning the roar of the sea, make the rivers, ponds, lakes and tanks overflow and flood the entire earth.
word_meanings: महाजलौघै: with heavy flow of water, समुद्धूतसमुद्रनादाः sea roaring heavily, गगनावलम्बाः hanging in the sky, मेघाः clouds, नदीः rivers, तटाकानि tanks, सरांसि lakes and ponds also, वापीः wells, कृत्स्नाम् entire, महीं च the earth, अपवाहयन्ति fill with flood waters.

text: वर्ष प्रवेगा विपुला पतन्तिप्रवान्ति वाताः समुदीर्ण वेगाः । प्रनष्ट कूलाः प्रवहन्ति शीघ्रम्नद्यो जलम् विप्रतिपन्न मार्गाः ॥४-२८-४५॥
translation: 'Torrents of rain pour at great speed. Winds roar. Rivers flow swiftly changing their direction due to breach in the banks
word_meanings: विपुलाः extensively, वर्षप्रवेगाः affected by the force of rain, पतन्ति are falling, समुदीर्णघोषाः creating roaring sound, वाताः winds, प्रवान्ति are blowing, प्रनष्टकूलाः banks destroyed, विप्रतिपन्नमार्गाः direction changed, नद्यः rivers, शीघ्रम् swiftly, जलै: water, प्रवहन्ति flowing.

text: नरैः नरेन्द्रा इव पर्वतेन्द्राःसुरेन्द्र नीतैः पवन उपनीतैः । घन अंबु कुम्भैः अभिषिच्यमानारूपम् श्रियम् स्वाम् इव दर्शयन्ति ॥४-२८-४६॥
translation: 'The mountains are consecrated with waterpitchers of clouds brought by the winds, offered by Lord Indra. Just as kings, consecrated by men, display their majesty, the mountains exhibit their form and glory. (Clouds are compared with water pots)
word_meanings: पर्वतेन्द्राः the great mountains, सुरेन्द्रनीतैः sent by lord of the gods, पवनोपदत्तै: served by the winds, घनाम्बुकुम्भैः water pitchers of clouds, नरैः by people, नरेन्द्रा इव like lords of the people, अभिषिच्यमानाः are consecrated, रूपम् form, स्वामिव their own, श्रियम् kingdom of wealth, इव like, दर्शयन्ति are showing.

text: घन उपगूढम् गगनम् न तारान भास्करो दर्शनम् अभ्युपैति । नवैः जल ओघैः धरणी वितृप्तातमो विलिप्ता न दिशः प्रकाशाः ॥४-२८-४७॥
translation: 'Ennveloped by clouds, the Sun and stars are not visible. The earth glides with the flow of fresh waters. The directions are not clear, covered by darkness.
word_meanings: गगनम् sky, घनोपगूढम् covered by clouds, भास्करः Sun, दर्शनम् appearance, स अभ्युपैति not to be seen, सतारं along with stars, न not, धरणी land, जलौघैः with water flow of, विसृप्ता gliding, तमोविलिप्ताः covered with darkness, दिशः direction, न प्रकाशाः not shining.

text: महान्ति कूटानि मही धराणाम्धारा विधौतानि अधिकम् विभान्ति । महा प्रमाणैः विपुलैः प्रपातैःमुक्त कलापैः इव लंबमानैः ॥४-२८-४८॥
translation: 'The huge mountain peaks are washed by the heavy downpour of rain which look like long strings of pearls hanging.
word_meanings: महीधराणाम् of the mountains, धाराभिधौतानि washed by the rain water, महान्ति huge, कूटानि mountain peaks, लम्बमानैः by the hanging, मुक्ताकलापैरिव like the strings of pearls, महाप्रमाणैः by long , विपुलैः by many, प्रपातैः water falling down, अधिकम् excessively, विभान्ति appeared.

text: शैलोपल प्रस्खलमान वेगाःशैलोत्तमानाम् विपुलाः प्रपाताः । गुहासु संनादित बर्हिणासुहारा विकीर्यन्त इव अवभान्ति ॥४-२८-४९॥
translation: 'The waterfalls rushing down the rocks on the huge mountains and flowing through caves, and peacocks singing create an image of broken and scattered chains of pearls.
word_meanings: शैलोपलप्रस्खलमानवेगाः water rushing down the rocks, विपुलाः large, प्रपाताः waterfalls, शैलोत्तमानाम् of great mountains, सन्नादितबर्हिणासु where peacocks are singing loudly, गुहासु in caves, हाराः chains, विकीर्यन्त इव broken and scattered, अवभान्ति appear.

text: शीघ्र प्रवेगा विपुलाः प्रपातानिर्धौत शृंग उपतला गिरीणाम् । मुक्ता कलाप प्रतिमाः पतन्तोमहा गुह उस्त्संग तलैः ध्रियन्ते ॥४-२८-५०॥
translation: 'The fast flow of waterfalls spread over vast areas completely wash the surroundings of the mountain peaks. It appears like chains of pearls collected in the lap of huge caves.
word_meanings: शीघ्रप्रवेगाः fast flow, विपुलाः huge, गिरीणाम् of the mountains, निर्धौतशृङ्गोपतलाः washing the surroundings of the mountain peaks, मुक्ताकलापप्रतिमाः like the chains of pearls, पतन्तः while falling, प्रपाताः waterfalls, महागुहोत्सङ्गतलैः by the laps of huge caves, ध्रियन्ते collected.

text: सुरताम् अर्द विच्छिन्नाः स्वर्ग स्त्री हार मौक्तिकाः । पतन्ति च अतुलाः दिक्षु तोय धाराः समन्ततः ॥४-२८-५१॥
translation: 'The strings of incomparable waterfalls all over the mountain appear as though pearls from the chains of sexually indulgent celestial women are dropping down from heaven, broken through physical friction.
word_meanings: सुरतामर्दविच्छिन्नाः broken by the rubbing of the bodies in sexualsport, स्वर्गस्त्रीहारमौक्तिकाः from the chains of the celestial women, च also, अतुलाः incomparable, तोयधाराः waterfalls, समन्ततः all over, दिक्षु in all directions, पतन्ति are fallen.

text: विलीयमानैः विहगैः निमीलद्भिः च पंकजैः । विकसन्त्या च मालत्या गतो अस्तम् ज्ञायते रविः ॥४-२८-५२॥
translation: 'The time of the setting Sun (as he remains invisible the whole day) is known only by the birds reaching out to their dwellings for rest, and by the closing of lotuses and blossoming jasmines.
word_meanings: निलीयमानैः by the resting, विहगैः by birds, निमीलद्भि closing, पङ्कजैः च by lotuses, विकसन्त्या by blooming, मालत्या च by Jasmines also, रविः Sun, अस्तंगतः has set, ज्ञायते is understood.

text: वृत्ता यात्रा नरेन्द्राणाम् सेना पथि एव वर्तते । वैराणि चैव मार्गाः च सलिलेन समीकृताः ॥४-२८-५३॥
translation: 'Expeditions by kings come to a stop. The army returns. The flow of water blocks the roads. It suspends enmity (between states).
word_meanings: नरेन्द्राणाम् kings, यात्रा expeditions, वृत्ता has been stopped, सेना army, प्रतिनिवर्तते is returning, सलिलेन with water, वैराणि enmities, चैव also, मार्गाश्च as well as roads also, समीकृताः are suspended.

text: मासि प्रौष्ठपदे ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणानाम् विवक्षताम् । अयम् अध्याय समयः सामगानाम् उपस्थितः ॥४-२८-५४॥
translation: 'The month of Bhadrapada meant for the recitation of the Vedas by brahmins and for those desirous of singing Sama Veda has started.
word_meanings: प्रोष्ठपदे मासि in the month of Bhadrapada, ब्रह्म the Veda, विवक्षताम् of those desirous of reciting, सामगानाम् study of the singers of Sama veda, ब्राह्मणानाम् of brahmins, अयम् this, अध्यायसमयः time of study, उपस्थितः started

text: निवृत्त कर्म आयतनो नूनम् संचित संचयः । आषाढीम् अभ्युपगतो भरतः कोसल अधिपः ॥४-२८-५५॥
translation: 'Surely Bharata, king of Kosala, would have completed the collection of all his requirement before the commencement of the month of Asarh.
word_meanings: निवृत्तकर्मायतनः completed all his work, सञ्चितसञ्चयः collected the requirements, कोसलाधिपः king of Kosala, भरतः Bharata, आषाढीम् month of Asarh, अभ्युपगतः has arrived नूनम् surely.

text: नूनम् आपूर्यमाणायाः सरय्वा वधते रयः । माम् समीक्ष्य समायान्तम् अयोध्याया इव स्वनः ॥४-२८-५६॥
translation: 'Just as the cheerful voices of people of Ayodhya rise as soon as they see me returning, certainly the speed of river Sarayu is rising, filled with rain water.
word_meanings: अपूर्यमाणायाः filled with water, सरव्या of Sarayu, रयः speed, समायान्तम् while I approach, माम् me, समीक्ष्य seeing, अयोद्यायाः in Ayodhya, स्वनः इव cheers like, वर्धते is rising, नूनम् surely.

text: इमाः स्फीत गुणा वर्षाः सुग्रीवः सुखम् अश्नुते । विजित अरिः स दारः च राज्ये महति च स्थितः ॥४-२८-५७॥
translation: 'Having defeated his enemy, Sugriva with his wife during the rainy season is wellestablished in the kingdom, abounding in merits.
word_meanings: विजितारिः won the enemy, सदारश्च with his wife, महति in great, राज्ये in kingdom, स्थितः च he attained, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, स्फीतगुणाः abounding in merits, इमाः वर्षाः during this rainy season, सुखम् happiness, अश्नुते experiencing.

text: अहम् तु हृत दारः च राज्यात् च महतः च्युतः । नदी कूलम् इव क्लिन्नम् अवसीदामि लक्ष्मण ॥४-२८-५८॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana I have lost my wife. I have been dethroned from the mighty kingdom. I am sinking like a river bank overflowed.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, हृतदारश्च with lost wife, महतः from the mighty, राज्यात् from the kingdom, च्युतश्च dethroned, अहं तु I am even, क्लिन्नम् overflowed with water, नदीकूलम् इव like the bank of river, अवसीदामि I am sinking.

text: शोकः च मम विस्तीर्णो वर्षाः च भृश दुर्गमाः । रावणः च महान् शत्रुः अपारम् प्रतिभाति मे ॥४-२८-५९॥
translation: 'My sorrow which increases, the rains which make it hard to cover distances and Ravana the great enemyall these appear difficult to conquer.
word_meanings: मम my, शोकश्च sorrow, विस्तीर्णः great, वर्षाश्च these rains, भृशदुर्गमाः difficult to cross, रावणश्च Ravana also, महान् great, शत्रुः enemy, मे me, अपारम् to cross over, प्रतिभाति it appears.

text: अयात्राम् चैव दृष्ट्वा इमाम् मार्गाम् च भृश दुर्गमान् । प्रणते चैव सुग्रीवे न मया किंचित् ईरितम् ॥४-२८-६०॥
translation: Seeing this suspension of the expedition and the very difficult roads, and since Sugriva is faithful to me, I said nothing.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवे when Sugriva, प्रणते चैव is faithful to me, इमाम् this, अयात्राम् suspending the expedition, भृशदुर्गमान् very difficult, मार्गांश्च road, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, मया myself, किञ्चित् even a little, न ईरितम् not spoken.

text: अपि च अति परिक्लिष्टम् चिरात् दारैः समागतम् । आत्म कार्य गरीयस्त्वात् वक्तुम् न इच्छामि वानरम् ॥४-२८-६१॥
translation: 'Since Sugriva has gone through great difficulties and is reunited with his wives after a long time and since our task is great, I did not desire to speak to him now.
word_meanings: अपिच and also, अतिपरिक्लिष्टम् one who experienced great difficulties, चिरात् after a long time, दारैः with his wife, समागतम् reunited, वानरम् monkey, आत्मकार्यगरीयस्त्वात् due to our task being greater, वक्तुम् to speak, नेच्छामि I do not desire.

text: स्वयम् एव हि विश्रम्य ज्ञात्वा कालम् उपागतम् । उपकारम् च सुग्रीवो वेत्स्यते न अत्र संशयः ॥४-२८-६२॥
translation: After resting and realizing that the time has come, Sugriva will himself recognize the help rendered—of this there is no doubt.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विश्रम्य after resting, कालम् time, उपागतम् has come, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, उपकारं च help also, स्वयमेव himself, वेत्स्यते will know, हि indeed, अत्र about that, संशयः doubt, न no.

text: तस्मात् काल प्रतीक्षो अहम् स्थितो अस्मि शुभ लक्षण । सुग्रीवस्य नदीनाम् च प्रसादम् अभिकांक्षयन् ॥४-२८-६३॥
translation: 'O Lakshmana of auspicious qualities I will wait for the proper time to appease Sugriva as well as the rivers.
word_meanings: शुभलक्षण hero endowed with auspicious qualities, तस्मात् therefore, अहम् I, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, नदीनां च of rivers also, प्रसादम् his grace, अनुपालयन् while waiting, कालप्रतीक्षः waiting for a favourable time, अस्मि I will.

text: उपकारेण वीरो हि प्रतिकारेण युज्यते । अकृतज्ञो अप्रतिकृतो हन्ति सत्त्ववताम् मनः ॥४-२८-६४॥
translation: A hero should in return help whoever has helped him. An ungrateful person hurts the heart of the virtuous by not returning the assistance.'
word_meanings: उपकारेण by a help, वीरः a hero, प्रतिकारेण by helping in turn, युज्यते a suitable step is taken, अकृतज्ञः ungrateful, अप्रतिकृतः one who does not help, सत्त्ववताम् of the virtuous people, मनः heart, हन्ति hurts.

text: अथ एवम् उक्तः प्रणिधाय लक्ष्मणःकृत अंजलिः तत् प्रतिपूज्य भाषितम् । उवाच रामम् स्वभिराम दर्शनम्प्रदर्शयन् दर्शनम् आत्मनः शुभम् ॥४-२८-६५॥
translation: Having heard this, Lakshmana expressed his considered opinion with due respect to handsome Rama:
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ then, एवं in this way, मुक्तम् expressed, प्रणिधाय after contemplating on it, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, भाषितम् speech, प्रतिपूज्य after honouring, आत्मनः self, शुभम् auspicious, दर्शनम् opinion, प्रदर्शयन् exhibited, स्वभिरामदर्शनम् a delightful one, रामम् to Rama, उवाच said.

text: यत् उक्तम् एतत् तव सर्वम् ईप्सितम्नर इन्द्र कर्ता नचिरा हरि ईश्वरः । शरत् प्रतीक्षः क्षमताम् इमम् भवान्जल प्रपातम् रिपु निग्रहे धृतः ॥४-२८-६६॥
translation: 'O Rama come Autumn, Sugriva will soon do all that you desire. Bear with the rains. Stay steadfast (in your determination) to destroy the enemy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किंधाकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: नरेन्द्र O king, यथा as, द्धरीश्वरः Sugriva, नचिरात् soon, तव your, ईप्सितम् desire, एतत् सर्वम् all this, कर्ता he will do, रिपुनिग्रहे in destroying the enemy, धृतः steadfast, भवान् you, शरत्प्रतीक्षः awaiting autumn, इमम् this, जलप्रपातम् water flow, क्षमताम् put up.

text: समीक्ष्य विमलम् व्योम गत विद्युत् बलाहकम् । सारसा आकुल संघुष्टम् रम्य ज्योत्स्ना अनुलेपनम् ॥४-२९-१॥
translation: Hanuman, son of the Windgod, saw the clear sky flooded with lovely moonlight, free from clouds and lightning and cackling of herons. He noticed that because Sugriva had attained abundant wealth and merit, he was not taking care of the kingdom. He was engrossed in sensual pleasures. Having accomplished the desired object, he was engaged in enjoyment of the company of women, his own wives and Tara, whom he coveted. Having decided to take him into confidence, Hanuman spoke in a convincing, wellmeaning, sweet, pleasing manner words truthful and helpful, conciliatory and just, full of love and affection:

text: हरीश्वरम् उपागम्य हनुमान् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् । राज्यम् प्राप्तम् यशः चैव कौली श्रीः अभिवर्थिता ॥४-२९-९॥
मित्राणाम् संग्रहः शेषः तत् भवान् कर्तुम् अर्हति । यो हि मित्रेषु कालज्ञः सततम् साधु वर्तते ॥४-२९-१०॥
तस्य राज्यम् च कीर्तिः च प्रतापः च अपि वर्धते । यस्य कोशः च दण्डः च मित्राणि आत्मा च भूमिप । समानि एतानि सर्वाणि स राज्यम् महत् अश्नुते ॥४-२९-११॥
तत् भवान् वृत्त संपन्नः स्थितः पथि निरत्यये । मित्रार्थम् अभिनीतार्थम् यथावत् कर्तुम् अर्हति ॥४-२९-१२॥
translation: 'Endowed with right conduct, you ought to duly answer the cause of your ally conforming to proper course of action.
word_meanings: तत् therefore, वृत्तसम्पन्नः endowed with right conduct, भवान् you, निरत्यये devoted, स्थितः conforming to, अभिनीतार्थम् a proper course of action, मित्रार्थम् for the cause of ally यथावत् duly, कर्तुम् doing, अर्हति it is proper.

text: संत्यज्य सर्व कर्माणि मित्रार्थम् यो न वर्तते । संभ्रमात् हि कृत उत्साहः सः अनर्थेन अवरुध्यते ॥४-२९-१३॥
translation: 'Whoever sets aside his personal interest and works for the welfare of his ally with due enthusiasm and excitement will not be harmed.
word_meanings: यः whoever, सर्वकर्माणि all his deeds, सन्त्यज्य by giving up, सम्भ्रमात् with excitement, कृतोत्साहः with enthusiasm, मित्रार्थे for the sake of ally, अनुवर्तते does follow, सः to him, अनर्थैः harms, न अवरुध्यते not obstructed.

text: यो हि काल व्यतीतेषु मित्र कार्येषु वर्तते । स कृत्वा महतो अपि अर्थान् न मित्रार्थेन युज्यते ॥४-२९-१४॥
translation: 'He who exceeds the time limit in accomplishing a friend's task, and puts forth great effort later succeeds not.
word_meanings: यः he who, कालव्यतीतेषु exceedng the time limit, मित्रकार्येषु in his friend's task, वर्तते acts, सः he, महतः great, अर्थान् effort, कृत्वा does, मित्रार्थेन for the cause of friend, न युज्यते not succeed.

text: तत् इदम् मित्रकार्यम् नः काल अतीतम् अरिंदम । क्रियताम् राघवस्य एतत् वैदेह्याः परिमार्गणम् ॥४-२९-१५॥
translation: 'O subduer of enemies we should do the brave deed of finding Vaidehi for the sake of your friend. O crusher of enemies this is your duty at present and it is already delayed.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, नः for us, तत् that, इदम् this, वीरकार्यम् heroic deed, मित्रकार्यम् for the sake of friend, वैदेह्यः Vaidehi's, परिमार्गणम् search, राघवस्य Rama's, एतत् this, क्रियताम् may be done, अरिन्दम O crusher of enemies, वीर hero, तत् that, इदम् this, कार्यम् task, ते to you, कालातीतम् already delayed.

text: न च कालम् अतीतम् ते निवेदयति कालवित् । त्वरमाणो अपि स प्राज्ञः तव राजन् वशानुगः ॥४-२९-१६॥
translation: 'O king a wise man (like Rama) who is aware of timely action would not tell you even if it is unduly delayed, even when he is in a hurry to get the work done, since he is staying in your kingdom (since he is dependant on you).
word_meanings: राजन् O king, प्राज्ञः a wise person, कालवित् one who is aware of the importance of timely action, सः he, त्वरमाणोऽपि even if he is in a hurry, तव your, वशानुगः staying( in your kingdom), अतीतम् exceeding, कालम् time, ते to you, न निवेदयति will not report.

text: कुलस्य हेतुः स्फीतस्य दीर्घ बन्धुः च राघवः । अप्रमेय प्रभावः च स्वयम् च अप्रतिमो गुणैः ॥४-२९-१७॥
translation: 'Rama is responsible in lending stability to you and to your wellknown family. He will continue to be your ally for a long time. Let it be known that his power is boundless and his virtues peerless.
word_meanings: राघवः Rama, स्फीतस्य prosperity, कुलस्य of your family, हेतुः responsible, दीर्घबन्धुश्च a long time ally, स्वयम् yourself, अप्रमेयप्रभावश्च a man of immeasurable power, गुणैः in virtues, अप्रतिमः peerless.

text: तस्य त्वम् कुरु वै कार्यम् पूर्वम् तेन कृतम् तव । हरीश्वर हरि श्रेष्ठान् आज्ञापयितुम् अर्हसि ॥४-२९-१८॥
translation: 'O king pray accomplish his object the same way he has accomplished your own. You ought to issue orders to the foremost of the monkeys.
word_meanings: हरीश्वर O king of monkeys, पूर्वम् earlier, तेन by him, तव to you, कृतम् done, त्वम् you, तस्य his, कार्यम् task, कुरु वै you may do, कपिश्रेष्ठान् आज्ञापयितुम् to order the best of monkeys, अर्हसि it will be proper for you.

text: न हि तावत् भवेत् कालो व्यतीतः चोदनात् ऋते । चोदितस्य हि कार्यस्य भवेत् काल व्यतिक्रमः ॥४-२९-१९॥
translation: 'Time will not be deemed lapsed in vain if the work is sincerely taken up without delay and without pressure from your ally, Rama. If it is undertaken under pressure, it will be considered transgression of time.
word_meanings: चोदनादृते before prompting, कालः time, व्यतीतः elapsed न तावत् भवेत् cannot be used, चोदितस्य if he directs, कार्यस्य the task, कालव्यतिक्रमः time limit has elapsed, भवेत् will happen.

text: अकर्तुर् अपि कार्यस्य भवान् कर्ता हरीश्वर । किम् पुनः प्रतिकर्तुः ते राज्येन च वधेन च ॥४-२९-२०॥
translation: 'O lord of monkeys help even a person who has not helped you. As such, do you need to be told that you should help one, with whose help you have earned wealth and kingdom?
word_meanings: हरीश्वर O lord of monkeys, कार्यस्य of the task, अकर्तुरपि even if one has not done the task, भवान् you, कर्ता doer, धनेन च wealth and, राज्येन च also kingdom, ते to you, प्रतिकर्तु: who performs the task in return, किं पुनः what to say again?

text: शक्तिमान् अतिविक्रान्तो वानर ऋष्क गण ईश्वर । कर्तुम् दाशरथेः प्रीतिम् आज्ञायाम् किम् नु सज्जसे ॥४-२९-२१॥
translation: 'O protector of the monkeys, you are powerful and you are prompt. Why don't you issue orders which will please Rama?
word_meanings: वानरर्क्षगणेश्वर O protector of the monkey force, शक्तिमान् powerful, विक्रान्तः advancing forward, दाशरथेः Dasaratha's Rama, प्रीतिम् pleasure, कर्तुम् to do, अज्ञायाम् in issuing orders, किं न सज्जसे why do you not get ready?

text: कामम् खलु शरैः शक्तः सुर असुर महा उरगान् । वशे दाशरथिः कर्तुम् त्वत् प्रतिज्ञाम् अवेक्षते ॥४-२९-२२॥
translation: 'Indeed, Rama is fully capable of subduing gods, demons as well as nagas with his arrows. He is looking for your help in view of your promise.
